item.text: I kept the old coat for years, long after it had become too small. One day, I found a cinema ticket tucked inside its pocket. I couldn’t remember the film, but I remembered the friend who had been with me—our laughter, the evening, the feeling of being young. I placed the ticket carefully in a drawer, then donated the coat. Letting it go felt less like losing the past than making room for what remains.
